_note: Held-out clause set, written BEFORE the eval-driven pattern fixes and never used to tune them. It shows how the rules-only mode handles brand-new wording.

clauses.text: Tenant must leave a $500 deposit to cover any damage.
Cats and dogs are forbidden in this building.
A $35 charge applies to rent paid after the due date.
Landlord may come in to inspect whenever he chooses, with no notice.
Tenant agrees to set up automatic monthly withdrawals for rent.
Rent may be increased with sixty days' notice.
Tenant is responsible for fixing all appliances and plumbing problems.
Overnight visitors are limited to two nights per week.
Tenant shall pay for hydro and gas.
A refundable deposit of $25 per key is required.
Tenant to carry contents and liability insurance.
Tenant will reimburse the landlord for damage caused by tenant's guests.
The building has a laundry room on the ground floor.
Tenant must vacate on or before the last day of the term.
Any NSF payment will result in a $45 administration fee.
